reviewer.note: Round 8 review at 7e7d310b (PR #458, round 2 of the Crossroads remainder), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 8. Pass for these bytes (094f7f27...). Ruling 1: walls 1.234 (>= 0.82); roof (stack out) 12.71 / 31.59 a patch (>= 11.9 / 27.9); roof noise 14.86 % raw (<= 15, on the line: see XR8-T3), 11.8 % through Eastward's pipe. Form as the hut: crest 0.54-0.60, body 0.71, roll-off 0.68 then 0.57 (rows 96-109), tips 0.87. XR7-T1 to T4 and T7 pass. detail.bar 0.706 (blocker) superseded for thatch by ruling 1; detail.volume [169,54,200,78] is the GR3 contact shade (false positive); the detail.light leads on glass, door and stone are unchanged in kind and kept as evidence.
fix_list: XR8-T1 (polish, recommended; Claude A's call): the straw is tan (roof median OKLab L 0.683, C 0.061, h 66) where the Crossroads' own hay bales are gold (hay_19 / hay_20: L 0.69-0.71, C 0.117, h 77-82) and shot 12's thatch C 0.137 (h 102). A golden straw needs no new tone: the kits already draw straw from brass, brass_warm and sand_warm (kit/farm.py STRAW, act1.py STRAW, commons.py); brass_warm 3 #ca9933 is L 0.71, C 0.128. Map the body and tips onto those ramps (shade stays on sand_cool), then re-measure ruling 1.

XR8-T2 (polish): the roll-off is short. On the centre column only the last 6-7 rows above the lip reach -0.08 L (0.571); the 8 rows before are a sibling step (0.683, -0.023). Grade 0.71 -> 0.65 -> 0.57 over 12-16 rows. The body's east-quarter step-down ends in a vertical seam (hut x 194-196 rows 76-88; herbalist x 175 rows 97-109) that reads as a darker rectangle at 3x; step the seam with the courses.

XR8-T3 (polish, robustness): the shipped seeds pass ruling 1, but the recipe sits on its lines. Re-drawn with seeds 1-24 through houses.building: 11 of 24 hut and 10 of 24 herbalist renders fail one number (raw noise median 14.4 / 14.2 %, max 17.4 / 15.9; tones median 12.08 / 12.23, min 11.36 / 11.84). Before the recipe changes again (XR8-T1) or ruling 1 becomes code, give it margin: raw noise <= 13.5 % and tones >= 12.3 at the shipped seed.

XR8-T4 (polish, XR7-T6 residue): the apron is now 2 rows, but the contact shade under it is still a ruler-straight 3-row band of #684441 (hut rows 65-67, x 178-208; herbalist rows 74-76, x 169-199); only its last row follows the tips.
XR8-T5 (polish): the ridge ligger is a 2-row bar cut into even dashes and reads as a dashed rule at 3x and up; give it a lit top row and uneven segment lengths.

XR8-T6 (polish): the east hip's outline has gaps on its stair: no dark edge texel on 30 of 62 rows on the hut and 20 of 82 on the herbalist, unchanged since round 2. With the hip now at L 0.55 (was 0.43), the gaps read as a dotted edge at 3x and up. Close it, or leave gaps only at the step corners.
